configurations.name: dashboard
runtimeArgs: cd dashboard && export TEAM_WALLETS=$(grep -E '^TEAM_WALLETS=' ../.env | sed -E 's/^TEAM_WALLETS=([^ #]*).*/\1/') ARC_ESCROW_ADDRESS=$(grep -E '^ARC_ESCROW_ADDRESS=' ../.env | sed -E 's/^ARC_ESCROW_ADDRESS=([^ #]*).*/\1/') HCS_TOPIC_ID=$(grep -E '^HCS_TOPIC_ID=' ../.env | sed -E 's/^HCS_TOPIC_ID=([^ #]*).*/\1/') HCS_BASELINE_TOPIC_ID=$(grep -E '^HCS_BASELINE_TOPIC_ID=' ../.env | sed -E 's/^HCS_BASELINE_TOPIC_ID=([^ #]*).*/\1/') LEDGER_PATH=./gateway/ledger.db && exec ./node_modules/.bin/next start -p 3100
